decision_scope: APPROVE_OR_REVISE_ONLY_CORE_FATHER_MOTHER_LEXEME_DIRECTION_AND_SELECTION; DO_NOT_REGISTER_NEW_FORMS ASSIGN_HNK3000_CREDIT DELETE_RECOVERED_PAPA_MAMA CREATE_PRODUCTIVE_PARENT_MORPHOLOGY OR ALTER_D03_L03_WITH_THIS_APPROVAL

proposed_decisions.proposal: Reject PAPA and MAMA as core HNK father/mother lexemes while retaining their recovered GATE evidence for historical traceability.
Reject exact PATRO and MATRA as final HNK forms because the external-resemblance risk is too high for HNK V3 lexical independence.
Select DARUNO as the authored primitive candidate for human father / pai.
Select NELARA as the authored primitive candidate for human mother / mãe.
Keep NEKUVO as generic parent/responsible-parent concept; DARUNO and NELARA do not establish a productive derivational paradigm from NEKUVO or from each other.
Treat DARUNO/NELARA as human-parent vocabulary only; theological titles such as God the Father require separate explicit governance.

approval_rule: A future SIGA in this parent-lexeme thread may approve only DEC-HNK-PARENT-001 through DEC-HNK-PARENT-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not register DARUNO/NELARA, assign HNK3000 credit, delete PAPA/MAMA historical evidence, create productive morphology, approve Wave04, approve B16 or alter L03/D03.
